description: An OSERDESE2 with T1 tied low drives its pad: no ZINV_T1
exercises: an OSERDESE2 whose tristate input T1 is tied to 0, TQ driving an IOBUF
the OLOGIC ZINV_T1 feature in the FASM writer
why: The packer turns the GND tie on T1 into the VCC net with IS_T1_INVERTED, and the site inverter must then stay active. Release 2026-10-14 also wrote ZINV_T1 from the rule for the TQ to pad path, which leaves the pad tri-stated for good: the output never drives, and the bitstream assembles all the same. openXC7/nextpnr#77 keeps ZINV_T1 off a tied-low T1. Vivado writes no ZINV_T1 for this design.
